facts.why: The film has a Christmas dinner at the Balboa house, but nothing calls it Christmas Eve, so the name drops the Eve.

facts.text: Christmas Eve back at the old house.
facts.why: The Christmas scene is at the Balboa mansion, before they lose it and move back to the old neighbourhood. Nothing says Eve.
facts.fix: Christmas dinner at the Balboa house.

facts.text: Mickey's old gym, handed down to Rocky
facts.why: Mickey willed the gym to Rocky's son. Rocky finds it run down and later reopens it.
facts.fix: Mickey's old gym, run down till Rocky reopens it

vibe.verdict: A decent bar tab concept, but the cover art is small and low-res, the header text is cut off, and most of the street fight is missing.
missing: Tommy Gunn called a paper champion
Rocky Jr. getting bullied at school
The street fight in the old neighbourhood
Rocky giving Robert Mickey's cufflink on the steps
ideas: Swap 'Eggnog with nutmeg and rum' for 'Sue me for what? shot'.
Swap 'Potato pierogi with fried onion' for 'Paper champion pierogi' as a nod to Tommy.
Fix the sign line so it is not cut off at 'CASH ONLY, NO CRED'.
Use a street fight still instead of the small poster.
